content: Given premises (1) All river barges inspected on Monday passed safety checks and (2) Every vessel that passes safety checks may operate that week, therefore explain in numbered steps why the barge scheduled for Wednesday can sail.
Because a security system alerts only when both the motion sensor and door latch are engaged, show step-by-step reasoning that demonstrates why an alert on Tuesday implies the room was accessed.

Construct a short proof using numbered statements that if every prototype uses component A, and component A requires calibration before shipment, thus each prototype must be calibrated prior to shipping.

List the logical chain, with explicit numbering, that starts from the assumption that servers X and Y replicate nightly, so therefore a corruption on server X implies an issue on server Y by the next morning.
Because each training cohort must either complete assessment Alpha or provide a waiver signed by leadership, detail a numbered argument showing why participants with neither document cannot graduate.
